reason: Replace the V2 implementation lineage because PR #206's first test-only commit did not prove the ambient-environment causal RED: its node -e argv contained a backslash escape and the existing runner rejected the command set with EVIDENCE_COMMAND_SET_INVALID before child environment inheritance was observed. The safe-diagnostic RED was causal, but V2 required both REDs in the first implementation commit. Published history cannot be amended, rebased, or force-pushed. V3 authorizes the same bottom-layer runner repair with a command-set-valid failure-first fixture and direct execution of the exact PVEP contract before product repair.

ossFit.basis: Repair the existing PVEP base-owned runner and its contract tests only, using Node.js core process primitives.

requiredGenericCapability.name: deterministicTrustedCommandEnvironmentAndFailureEvidence
requirements: Base-owned command execution must not inherit ambient Node process-control variables such as NODE_OPTIONS or NODE_PATH.

The child environment must be constructed from an explicit minimal cross-platform allowlist required for executable discovery and temporary-directory operation; arbitrary workflow or runner variables must not flow through by default.
Environment key matching must account for Windows case-insensitive environment semantics.
The trusted command set remains the sole authority for executable, argv, expected exit code, generated roots, and artifact declarations.
A failed child command must still produce the existing evidence JSON with verificationStatus VERIFIED_FAIL before the runner exits nonzero.

Failure diagnostics written to stderr must be machine-verifiable and include commandId, expected/observed exit code, signal or spawn error code, and stdout/stderr digests, without raw child output or environment values.
Workspace Head and dirty-worktree fail-closed checks remain unchanged.
No retry, timeout relaxation, ignored failure, fallback command, shell execution, or candidate-controlled override is permitted.

requiredCausalRed: The first V3 implementation commit changes only tests/verification/pvep-trusted-runner-contract.test.js.

The exact directRedCommand must be executed against the exact first Head before product repair; Stage test:wp0 success is not a substitute because tools/wp0/run-tests.js enumerates only tests/wp0/*.test.js.
The ambient-environment trusted command fixture must satisfy the existing validateCommandSet contract and must not contain a backslash in executable or argv.

The ambient test must reach trusted child execution and fail because current execution inherits NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_PATH, or an arbitrary ambient variable, not because validation or fixture setup failed.
The deliberate child-failure test must fail only because structured child-failure diagnostics are absent while VERIFIED_FAIL evidence is preserved.
requiredGreen: The same command-set-valid trusted command passes with hostile parent NODE_OPTIONS and NODE_PATH because those variables are not inherited by the child.
Arbitrary ambient variables are absent from the child environment unless explicitly allowlisted as platform-critical.
A deliberate child exit remains fail-closed and emits structured digest-only diagnostics with no raw child output.
Existing base-owned runner, exact-Head, workspace cleanliness, trusted command-set ownership, evidence digest, and subject binding tests remain GREEN on Linux and Windows.
